content: {"like": ["The Blu‑ray looks beautiful and has never looked better on home video.", "The grainy texture is acceptable and does not suffer from excessive noise reduction.", "The 5.1 DTS HD audio mix sounds good with no phasing artifacts."], "dislike": ["The film is a bit grainy at times due to the original film stock.", "The 5.1 DTS HD mix has excessive channel separation and the user has misgivings about it.", "The Spanish and French audio mixes are very bright, harsh, and the Spanish mix is painful to listen to.", "The extras are not special and offer little value."]}
